description: Single and two storey side to rear extension, Single storey side extension, Alterations to garage roof to lower height, Roof lights in front, side and rear roof slopes, External alterations
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site Location Plan; Existing Site Plan [Page 1 of 10 REV 1 dated Jan 2025]; Existing Ground Floor Plan [Page 2 of 10 REV 1 dated Jan 2025]; Existing First Floor Plan [Page 3 of 10 REV 1 dated Jan 2025]; Existing Roof Plan [Page 4 of 10 REV 1 dated Jan 2025]; Proposed Site Plan [Page 5 of 10 REV 2 dated Mar 2025]; Proposed Ground Floor Plan [Page 6 of 10 REV 2 dated Mar 2025]; Proposed First Floor Plan [Page 7 of 10 REV 2 dated Mar 2025]; Proposed Roof Plan [Page 8 of 10 REV 2 dated Mar 2025]; Existing Elevations [Page 9 of 10 REV 1 dated Jan 2025]; Proposed Elevations [Page 10 of 10 REV 2 dated Mar 2025].
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension/s hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building (red London stock brick, white painted concrete cladding, terracotta roof tiles and white framed windows) only, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;

The window(s) in the western side elevation of the proposed development shall:

(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass; and

(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed at ground floor of the eastern or western side elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
